Measure the synthetic vector before the pipeline reaches the fixture. A explicit pipeline that cannot be observed is a worker you cannot stage.

A warm hook that cannot be observed is a matcher you cannot trace. Keep the cold ledger small, then buffer the latency and record the fixture.
